provenance.sourceKind: Community documentation, distinct from client native and configuration evidence

sources.title: 元素
sources.observations: ANGER has separate character/other effects: character +50 attack speed, true pulses increasing on qualifying ability spells; other +20 speed, elemental pulses with +130 per second. The page states ability spell timing and the ignore-palsy exclusion.

sources.title: 镜匠
sources.observations: Ordinary playable operator: S1 applies ANGER to blocked enemies; S2 also applies ANGER and converts part of incoming physical/magical damage to self ANGER. Used only as a community cross-check; concrete bindings and nonzero values are archived in content.json.

sources.title: 术语释义
sources.observations: Explicitly corrects the nominal enemy 2110 cap: actual damage has no fixed cap and follows 160 + 130 times elapsed seconds. Native producer confirms increment-before-pulse.
